question: Gangaur festival of Rajasthan is associated with which god and goddess?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Lord Shiva and Goddess Parwati.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Gangaur festival :-**

 
 
• **The Gangaur festival of Rajasthan is associated with the god Lord Shiva and the goddess Gauri, who is a manifestation of Parvati, Shiva's consort. **
 
• The name Gangaur is a combination of the words "Gan" and "Gaur", which refer to Shiva and Gauri respectively.
 
• **The Gangaur festival is celebrated in the spring season, during the month of Chaitra (March-April). **
 
• It is a colorful and joyous festival that celebrates the marital bond, fertility, and the arrival of spring.
 
• The festival is particularly popular among women, who dress up in their finest clothes and jewelry and participate in various rituals and celebrations.
 
• The Gangaur festival is a time for women to come together and celebrate their womanhood.
 

 
 
• It is also a time to pray for marital bliss, fertility, and the well-being of their families.
